summary: Predict.fun crypto price-prediction Edge scanner. Consumes a market snapshot (markets + their Yes/No prices) plus per-symbol kline OHLCV; computes 7-factor true probability, compares with implied price to identify positive Edge, and applies quarter-Kelly sizing.
core_logic: Accept prediction_markets list with strike, current price, end_time, yes_price, no_price.
For each market, compute 7 signals (RSI/MACD/EMA cross/funding/long_short/orderbook_imbalance/volume_breakout) and weighted probability P_true.
Edge = P_true - implied_price; positive Edge above edge_threshold → trade candidate.
Position sizing: quarter_kelly = 0.25 * full_kelly, capped at single_market_max_pct of capital.
Apply portfolio gates: max total exposure, daily market cap.
recommended_next_step: Use BAW wallet to place Yes/No orders on candidates with Edge >= edge_threshold; monitor via watcher.
